newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down as investors book profit.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down as investors book profit.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down on Monday as investors booked profits, ending a three-day rally, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index fell 5.13 points or 0.42 percent on turnover of 111 million taka. Of the issues traded 71 closed lower, 57 ended higher and four remained unchanged.
Anwar Galvanizing Ltd lost 14.12 taka to 168.57, Meghna Cement rose 21.51 to 593.17, Shine Pukur Holding fell 11.65 to 105.93 and Reckitt & Colman was down 2.9 to 177.53.
Brokers said the market was going through a correction and the shares might continue to fall in the next few sessions.
